For a ₹10,000 delivery trade on Zerodha, round-trip cost is ₹38.15 (0.38%) requiring that move just to break even before 20% STCG tax. Given the rising India VIX (+7.15% today) and Nifty downtrend, I’d wait for post-earnings confirmation after Oct 17 before considering a position.
